IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Higher Education.

Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a higher education registration priority for eligible veterans and national guard members.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to higher education registration priority foreligible veterans and national guard members; adding a new section tochapter 28B.15 RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Institutions of higher education shall give students who areeligible veterans or national guard members priority duringregistration. "Eligible veterans and national guard members" includesthose defined in RCW 28B.15.621 and veterans or national guard memberswho have fought in Afghanistan or Iraq during conflicts that arosefollowing September 11, 2001. Priority registration may be given to abroader group of veterans or national guard members. (2) Private and independent institutions of higher education areencouraged to provide priority registration to eligible veterans andnational guard members as defined in subsection (1) of this section. (3) This section expires July 1, 2022.
